definitions.full: H5896. Ira עִירָא proper name, masculine (see Sabean proper name, masculine עיר Hal 159 ); — 1 כֹּהֵן (q. v. 1 ) of David 2Sam 20:26 ; on possibly ident. with 2b see Th Klo HPS, opposed to We Dr; Ειρας , ᵐ5 L Ιωδαε . 2 heroes of David ( Ειρας , etc., ᵐ5 L Ιδεα , Οιαδ , etc.): a. 2Sam 23:26 = 1Chr 11:28 ; 27:9 . b. 2Sam 23:38 = 1Chr 11:40 .
